headline: Alexandru Nazare Told the European Commissioner for Economy that Romania Is Determined to Remain Consistent on the Path of Deficit Reduction
summary: Finance Minister Alexandru Nazare told EU Economy Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis that Romania will remain consistent on deficit reduction, on the margins of the ECOFIN meeting.
why: Romania's budget deficit is closely watched by EU institutions and investors, and fiscal consolidation affects its government bond yields and credit ratings.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Alexandru Nazare i-a transmis comisarului european pentru economie că România este determinată să rămână consecventă pe traiectoria de reducere a deficitului
